quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on the significance of his first NBA start
quotes.excerpt: to be able to contribute to winning so early in the season by starting the game
quotes.quote: It means everything to me. You obviously dream of getting here, but then to be able to contribute to winning so early in the season by starting the game and being able to help you guys out, it just means the world to me. I can't thank my teammates and team enough.
quotes.social_post: Meleek Thomas on his first NBA start: It means everything to me. You dream of getting here, but to be able to contribute to winning so early in the season by starting the game, it just means the world to me.

structured.context: Meleek Thomas discusses his emotions and experience after making his first NBA start for the Cavaliers.

quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on his defensive approach against Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: with a guy that's so gifted at that scoring, you just try to contain him
quotes.quote: With a guy that's so gifted at that scoring, you just try to contain him to the best ability that you can. We got our coverages and schemes for it, but if he is getting into that, then it's just mano a mano. Just try to get your best out there, be physical, and force tough shots.
quotes.social_post: Meleek Thomas on defending Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: With a guy that is so gifted at scoring, you just try to contain him to the best ability that you can. If he is getting into that, then it is just mano a mano.

quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on his chemistry with James and Donovan Mitchell
quotes.excerpt: those are very ball-dominant guys, so you got to work your way to know how they play
quotes.quote: I would say I've grown a lot. Those are very ball-dominant guys, so you got to work your way to know how they play and what's best off of them and what works best off of them. Just me finding the windows, finding the right space to be in, knowing their tendencies and also knowing mine and how they can mesh at the same time. I feel like I'm doing a very good job, but always room for improvement, so I will get better as the season goes on.

quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on the spontaneity of his first NBA start
quotes.excerpt: it just so spontaneous, it just happened quick and got to be ready for that moment
quotes.quote: I tried to let it sink in a little bit. It just so spontaneous, it just happened quick and got to be ready for that moment when your name's called. So I try to let it sink in, but as everything's going on, it's just you got to be ready to gear up.

quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on the importance of precision and effort in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: if you're precise and you're punctual, defensively and offensively, then good things are going to happen
quotes.quote: It's just that if you're precise about everything on the court, if you're precise and you're punctual, defensively and offensively, then good things are going to happen because you're in the right spaces, you're doing the right things.
